newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads two Pakistanis for drug smuggling.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads two Pakistanis for drug smuggling.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded two Pakistani men for smuggling heroin into the kingdom, the official Saudi Press Agency reported.
An Interior Ministry statement carried by SPA said the two were beheaded in Medina.

The beheadings raised to 66 the number of executions this year in the conservative Islamic kingdom. It enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals.
